subject: Request: Hybrid Quarterly/Net-90 Billing Exception — SprintBridge
messages:
From: Lily Park <lily.park@sprintbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Billing cadence question for PO #7789

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team is excited to move forward. Procurement looped me in with the PO (attached). There are two asks on our side around billing:

- SprintBridge prefers quarterly invoicing for enterprise agreements.
- For this initial multi-quarter commitment we need Net-90 on the first two invoices so our finance team can align with customer billing cycles.

Is that something Redwood can accommodate? If not exactly Net-90, could we do a hybrid approach (quarterly invoices but payment term Net-60 for final quarter)?

Attached: PO_7789.pdf

Best,
Lily Park

SprintBridge

Appreciate the clarity and the PO. Ben and I have discussed options; we typically invoice monthly or net-30 for hosted accounts, but we do support custom cadences for enterprise with an approval.

I will open an internal exception request. Can you confirm:
- whether SprintBridge needs Net-90 on invoice #1 and #2 specifically (yes/no)
- whether there are any legal/payment exceptions (wire only, remit-to different entity, etc.)

I attached a proposed invoice schedule for our initial ask so you can confirm alignment.

Thanks,

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: Billing cadence question for PO #7789 — request for Net-90 on initial invoices

Team — forwarding SprintBridge request. Quick summary:
- ARR: $420k/year, 2-year commitment (50% upfront is standard in our playbook).
- SprintBridge asks for quarterly invoices, with Net-90 on the first two quarters (they claim internal cycle alignment).
- They are OK with a smaller discount if we can offer the Net-90 terms; they want it baked into the contract ASAP.

Suggested approach: two options for approval
A) Approve hybrid: Invoice Q1 and Q2 with Net-90, Q3/Q4 standard Net-30. Require a 3% non-refundable setup fee or 7.5% price uplift to compensate cashflow.
B) Approve only quarterly invoicing with Net-60 across the board and a 3% discount reduction (less favorable for them).

Both options require Finance sign-off and a CRO exception for the cashflow exposure. Attaching pricing summary and draft schedule.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_summary_v3.pdf, proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Billing cadence question for PO #7789 — request for Net-90 on initial invoices

Ben/Hannah —

Thanks for the heads up. High level Finance perspective:
- Net-90 on the first two invoices for a $420k ARR deal materially impacts cashflow for Q1/Q2.
- If we approve, require: 1) recorded PO and confirmation of remittance entity, 2) credit check / trade references, 3) a short-term working capital protection (3% uplift OR pre-funded escrow until invoice schedule stabilizes).

I can provisionally approve Option A (hybrid Net-90 for first two quarters with 7.5% uplift) subject to CRO sign-off on the exception and legal adding the payment terms into the SOW. Please escalate to Marissa for final authority on the uplift and SLA exceptions.

-Jonas
Director of Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Requesting CRO approval: Hybrid quarterly/Net-90 exception for SprintBridge (RDW-2026-00731)

Marissa —

Forwarding request for formal CRO approval. Context in short:
- Account: SprintBridge (enterprise) — 2-year deal, $420k ARR.
- External ask: quarterly invoices; Net-90 on invoices 1 and 2.
- Finance (Jonas) provisionally ok with Option A: approve Net-90 on first two quarters with a 7.5% uplift to compensate cashflow risk + credit check and PO on file.

Attachments included for quick review: PO from SprintBridge, pricing summary, proposed invoice schedule.

Proposed sign-off language (to include in approval email):
"Redwood Inference approves a one-time billing-term exception for SprintBridge (Deal RDW-2026-00731): Redwood will invoice on a quarterly cadence; SprintBridge will have Net-90 payment terms on invoices 1 and 2. In exchange, SprintBridge accepts a 7.5% pricing uplift on the first invoice set and agrees to a documented PO/remit entity and successful credit check. Exception expires at the end of the initial 2-quarter period unless otherwise renegotiated."

Can you confirm approval (or adjustments) and whether legal should add a specific clause to the SOW or we should issue an addendum?

Thanks — running against SprintBridge deadlines, would appreciate a reply before EOD.

Best,
Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal.ops@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Requesting CRO approval: Hybrid quarterly/Net-90 exception for SprintBridge (RDW-2026-00731)

Thanks team — reviewed. Approve the exception with the following firm conditions:
1) 7.5% uplift on the first two quarterly invoices (documented in SOW addendum).
2) Procurement must provide a signed PO referencing the Redwood SOW and remit-to details before first invoice date.
3) Finance to run a credit check and confirm acceptable risk threshold.
4) Legal to draft a one-paragraph addendum that limits the exception to the first two invoices and includes recovery/late-fee language if payment exceeds Net-90 + 15 days.

Once Legal confirms the addendum language, Hannah — please send the revised SOW + addendum + DocuSign envelope to SprintBridge and include the uplift line item in the invoice schedule.

Marissa Cole
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
